entries.whatItMarks: The festival of sacrifice during Hajj.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Reports show a pattern rather than one Somali-only event. Eid prayers draw large crowds at shared Muslim sites: CBS Minnesota reported tens of thousands at the Minneapolis Convention Center on June 28, 2023, quoting the executive director of Abubakar As-Saddique Islamic Center, and 'Super Eid' filled U.S. Bank Stadium in 2018 and on July 9, 2022. The convention center's 2026 calendar lists Eid al-Adha on May 26/27, 2026, without naming an organizer. Afterward many families go to the Mall of America; in 2016 FOX 9 quoted Somali organizer Abdi Bihi calling the mall 'part of our Somali culture here in Minnesota,' and in 2024 Somali community leaders, the mall and Bloomington police planned Eid safety together. Sahan Journal reported in 2020 that some Muslims, including a Somali Minnesotan, perform the sacrifice at farms such as Meat Halal Farm in Braham, and in 2021 that Minneapolis bakeries make thousands of pounds of halwa for the holiday. No 2026 report of a Somali-specific Eid al-Adha event was found.
